_description:
belgeler/wiki/boxes.md (darkorbitwiki: boxes) -> server/data/boxes.json: keyed loot boxes on the maps.

Box types are the client's own names (AddBoxCommand.boxType; PIRATE_BOOTY = Green Booty Box in the translation file …), keys are the client's item ids (resource_booty-key …), the keyless pickup text is the client's msg_loot_failed_no_booty-key-* keys,
"booty_key_<type>_used" in the logbook, the key counter in the HUD is the old protocol's "0|A|<code>|<count>" line (SetAttributeAssemblyHelper.AssembleBootyKeysUpdate: BK green,
BKR red, BKB blue, BKS silver, BKBB obsidian, BKBLC / BKBLD Black Light Cipher / Decoder).
Contents are from the wiki: the group and in-group probabilities and quantities of the red, blue and obsidian boxes as is; for the green, gold and silver
boxes the wiki gives no quantity or probability (quantity from the AMOUNTS table, weight from the WEIGHTS table: adaptation). Black Light Cache: a Centurion
design (10,000 uridium if owned, wiki); Black Light Crypt: X1 / X2 ship modules (the wiki's "?" rows are skipped).
Box counts and respawn times are adaptation; gold boxes are on the 2nd and 4th Friday of the month; E8: Obsidian, R&B and Apocalypse in weekly
rotation (event_calendar.py obsidian_booty, rb_booty, apocalypse_booty; the real game's bp-calendar), Perseus' Blessing in Perseus' Grace,
Battle Pass Box in events with a Battle Pass (contents are the event's group: 'reward_event').
E7: Astral (BKA), Prime Astral (BKAP), Apocalypse (MASQUE_BOOTY_BOX, BKM), Prometheus (BKPR), Perseus' Blessing (BKPG) and
Laurel (BKLL) boxes; the codes were matched by name from the "0|A|BK…|0" lines of the login in the recording. Where the wiki gives no quantity, the quantity is AMOUNTS_E7
(adaptation); the wiki's misspelled rows or those that appear under another name in the client are in E7_NAMES (XHV02 = XV02, HP-XHU2 = HP-XU02, CC-A / CC-C =
Cosmic Class A / C, Prime Coupon = PrimeCoupon, Travel Permit = Deep Space Echoes ticket; Booster Package: 10 hours of the damage booster,
adaptation). "Package:" rows are Epic design packages: ['package', [[lootId, count] …], weight], on opening the whole package is given
(loot.pick_all; a design already owned is skipped from the package). Prometheus and Laurel's key has no source: their calendars are E8's
events (prometheus, athena), they do not spawn until that day.
Module sources (adaptation): modules sold in the extra shop and, per the wiki, won through an event go into that event's Battle Pass Box
column with very low weight (BP_EXTRA); the modules of Chromin Rush and Eternal Gate, which have no Battle Pass, were left to those events' own tools.
Generated by: tools/boxes.py.

PERSEUS_BLESSING_BOOTY_BOX.name: Perseus Blessing
PERSEUS_BLESSING_BOOTY_BOX._forum_tr: Official Turkish forum 1451139, 1455900: Permit Plus and other items (mine, Extra Energy, P.E.T. Fuel, Repair Voucher, Uridium/Credits); quantities and weights are adaptation

BATTLEPASS.name: Battle Pass Box
BATTLEPASS._forum_tr: Official Turkish forum: Plutus box (A-BL 15%, Nobilis Plus designs 0.2%, Orcus/Pusat P.E.T. 0.25%/0.3%; NOS01/SEN01/TAR01 are not in the forum: since it is the only source of these modules they stay at 0.4% as an adaptation), Astral (Mucosum 5%, Astral Pusat Plus 1%), Winter/Labyrinth (Citadel Plus Frost 0.5%; XW01 is not in the forum): each table totals 100%

EMPYRIAN_BOOTY_BOX.name: Empyrian Box
EMPYRIAN_BOOTY_BOX._source: wiki: stage and item probabilities, Epic design packages

PROSPEROUS_BOOTY_BOX.name: Prosperous Box
PROSPEROUS_BOOTY_BOX._source: wiki: stage and item probabilities, Epic design packages; DMG-VEN01 (wiki: Plague Mutation reward, mapped to Prosperous) with 0.4% weight (adaptation)

LUCENT_ALIEN_EGG_BOOTY_BOX.name: Lucent Egg
LUCENT_ALIEN_EGG_BOOTY_BOX._source: wiki: contents (no probabilities: designs 0.5% weight, others 3; adaptation)

APOTHEOSIS.name: Apotheosis Booty Box
APOTHEOSIS._source: board-en 130459 (FAQ Kristallon Apotheosis): 20 boxes when Emperor Kristallon is defeated; the client's box_APOTHEOSIS asset, HUD counter BKAPO

_event_boxes: EMPYRIAN_BOOTY_BOX, PROSPEROUS_BOOTY_BOX, LUCENT_ALIEN_EGG_BOOTY_BOX via tools/event_boxes.py; calendar = event name.
